text: Best service

I'm so depressed.

It feels like I was scammed. I went there for the first time many years ago, so I have a history, but I wasn't impressed. The dentist rushed the process. After that, I never went back. It cost me 1200 baht.

Five years passed (they called constantly, but I never went).

This time, they sent an SMS saying there was a voucher. I thought, "Okay, I get tartar removed every 4 months anyway. Normally, I don't have much plaque because I get it done so often. I don't have any cavities. I go to my regular clinic."

This time, I fell for the freebie and agreed. They said 900-1500 baht, but with my social security benefits, I could use 1200 baht.

I immediately thought, because because I get tartar removed so often at other clinics, I've always paid 900 baht plus a small fee for equipment. This year, I've already used my company's benefits twice, so I only have one more social security benefit left to use at the end of the year. When I saw the promotion, I decided to use it here.

In short, the scaling only took 15 minutes. They put a tube across my chest, the assistant used a suction tube, only hitting my uvula. I gagped several times. The water spray went into my nose, causing me to choke. The dentist rushed the scaling. To be honest, I was extremely unimpressed.

In summary, the total was 1400 baht + 150 baht for the equipment, bringing the total to 1550 baht. I was shocked! They said they'd reduce the price by 200 baht if I didn't take the voucher. After deducting social security, I only had to pay an additional 250 baht.

The staff also asked if the doctor recommended any X-rays or other treatments. I told them truthfully that the doctor hadn't mentioned anything. They then gave me a form to sign stating my refusal of X-ray treatment. They said I just needed to sign it and the staff would handle the rest. I saw the box for "accepting treatment" but I wanted to tick it because the doctor didn't inform me, but I decided to just ignore it. That's it, I'm done with this place.

In short, the 900 baht figure was completely false. I cheated on my regular clinic, but I'm never coming back.
